prompt: What is the color of the white horse of Santiago?
response: The white horse associated with Santiago (Saint James) is, as the name suggests, white. In legends and religious iconography, Santiago is often depicted riding a white horse, symbolizing purity, divinity, and his role as a saint. This imagery is particularly prominent in the context of the legend of the "Santiago Matamoros" (Saint James the Moor-slayer) in Spanish history and folklore, where he is said to have appeared riding a white horse to aid Christian forces.
